evidence: Changes wallet resubmission logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/wallet.h, and carries the 'Wallet' label.
rationale: Prevents the wallet from undermining user privacy expectations by suppressing periodic resubmissions of unconfirmed transactions under `-privatebroadcast`. Leaving this unresolved allows unexpected wallet rebroadcasts (such as incoming dust payments) to trigger clearnet announcements.
